scenes.narration: Meet gTabs. The AI tab organizer for Chrome.
You have twenty four tabs open. You can't find anything. Sound familiar?
One click on gTabs, and your tabs organize themselves into color coded groups. Dev, Media, Comms. Instantly.

scenes.title: It learns from you
scenes.narration: Every correction you make counts triple. Every rejected group is remembered for thirty days. gTabs gets smarter the more you use it.

scenes.title: 8 providers. 3 completely free.
scenes.narration: Works with Groq, OpenRouter, and Ollama for free. Or bring your own key for Claude, GPT, and more.

scenes.title: Schedule it. Pin it. Forget it.
scenes.narration: Set daily re-organization. Pin your important groups. They survive every re-org automatically.
gTabs. Open source, free, and ready to try. Star it on GitHub.
